C12 Distributed Virtual Memory Transactions
                                                                                      C12.6 DVM transaction restrictions


C12.6  DVM transaction restrictions

                    Table C12-4 shows the constraints that apply to the DVM read address and write address channel signals.

                                                                      Table C12-4 DVM transaction constraints

 Attribute          Constraint

 ARADDR         Must be zero for DVM Complete.

 ARBURST          Burst type must be INCR.

 ARLEN           The burst length must be 1, that is ARLEN[7:0] must be 0b00000000. See Address structure on page A3-44 for
                   more information.

 ARSIZE          The number of bytes in a transfer must be equal to the data bus width. See Burst size on page A3-45.

 ARCACHE        Must be Modifiable and Non-cacheable, that is ARCACHE[3:0] must be 0b0010. See Table A4-4 on page A4-64
                         for more information.

 ARPROT        No constraint, can take any value.

is ARCACHE[3:0] must be 0b0010. See Table A4-4 on page A4-64
                         for more information.

 ARPROT        No constraint, can take any value.

 ARLOCK         Must be a normal access, that is ARLOCK must be 0.

 ARSNOOP        Must be either:
                            •   DVM Operation or DVM Sync, that is, ARSNOOP[3:0] must be 0b1111
                            •   DVM Complete, that is, ARSNOOP[3:0] must be 0b1110.

 ARDOMAIN      The domain must be Inner Shareable or Outer Shareable.

 ARBAR           Must be a normal access, that is AxBAR[0] must be 0.

 ACADDR         Must be zero for DVM Complete.

 ACPROT        No constraint, can take any value.

 ACSNOOP        Must be either:
                            •   DVM Operation or DVM Sync, that is, ACSNOOP[3:0] must be 0b1111
                            •   DVM Complete, that is, ACSNOOP[3:0] must be 0b1110.
